rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Effective April 1, 2017, Winthrop-University Hospital affiliated with NYU Langone Health System and rebranded as NYU Winthrop Hospital. Initial phase of multi-step integration.

rating_actions_in_window.to: WITHDRAWN / absorbed into NYU Langone (Aa3 tier)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: NYU Langone Health and NYU Winthrop completed full-asset merger September 27, 2019, expanding NYU Langone system by 25%. Standalone Winthrop bonds either refunded or absorbed into NYU Langone obligated group; standalone Moody's Baa2 rating effectively superseded by the materially stronger NYU Langone Aa3-tier credit.

outcome_class_rationale: Standalone Winthrop-University Hospital Baa2/BBB+ rating terminated at September 27 2019 full-asset merger with NYU Langone. Two-step deal: April 2017 affiliation began, September 2019 full merger closed. From a 2016 BBB+/Baa2 obligor lens, this is a strongly credit-positive outcome — absorption into Aa3-tier parent.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: FY16 figures industry-typical estimates for 600-bed Long Island academic medical center at Baa2/BBB+ tier. Specific audited revenue and DCOH not retrievable from blind-window sources within research scope.

_research_notes: Two-stage deal: 2017 affiliation, 2019 full-asset merger. Winthrop is now NYU Langone Hospital Long Island (Mineola). Adds ~70 ambulatory sites + flagship LI hospital to NYU Langone footprint. Credit-positive trajectory from start.
